## What the candidate does

Product definition plus AI-assisted delivery. Writes the specification and acceptance
criteria, models the data, directs coding agents, then tests and reviews the output.
Not positioned as a traditional software developer: the differentiator is judgement on
product and data, not manual coding speed.

## Skills

- Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite. Schema design, joins, aggregations, queries,
  data quality.
- Reporting: Excel and spreadsheets, reports, metrics, KPI tracking, LaTeX, Markdown.
- Product: requirements gathering, scope, acceptance criteria, process modeling,
  research, benchmarking, technical writing.
- AI: coding agents (Codebuff/Freebuff, Antigravity, Android Studio SDK), prompt
  engineering, LLM output evaluation against rubrics and written guidelines.
- Engineering: TypeScript, React, Node.js, Python, Prisma, Redis, Docker, Git.
- Languages: Spanish native; English C1 technical reading, B1+ speaking.

## Projects

- Farmacy ERP (https://github.com/SCP-00/farmacy-erp): pharmacy ERP with offline-capable
  POS, FEFO batch inventory, RBAC, four payment gateways and 693 automated tests.
- BodyLab + TrainingLab (https://github.com/SCP-00/Fitness): local-first desktop
  ecosystem with a versioned data contract between both apps. Live demo:
  https://scp-00.github.io/Fitness/
- Alex Teacher (https://github.com/SCP-00/alex-teacher): on-device voice language tutor
  built on Whisper, llama.cpp and Kokoro TTS.
